question: In March 2025, which national day or week emphasised industrial workplace safety?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Safety Week**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• National Safety Week is observed annually in India from **March 4th to March 10th** to promote safety awareness in industrial workplaces and other sectors.
 
• The initiative was started by the **National Safety Council (NSC)**, a non-profit organization established by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India, in 1966.
 
• It aims to raise awareness about the importance of safety protocols, accident prevention, and promoting a safety-first culture in industries.
 
• The week includes activities like safety training programs, workshops, poster campaigns, and quizzes emphasizing workplace safety.
 
• The theme for National Safety Week varies each year, focusing on specific aspects of industrial and occupational safety.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Safety Council (NSC):**

 
 
• Established on 4 March 1966 by the Ministry of Labour and Employment, India, NSC is a non-governmental organization focused on promoting safety awareness.
 
• It plays a critical role in implementing safety measures and conducting training sessions across various industries.
 
 
 
• **Occupational Safety and Health (OSH):**
 
 
• OSH refers to practices and policies aimed at ensuring the health, safety, and welfare of workers in their workplaces.
 
• Common hazards include physical, chemical, biological, and ergonomic risks.
 
 
 
• **Industrial Accidents:**
 
 
• An industrial accident is an unexpected event that results in injury, illness, or fatalities within a workplace.
 
• Major causes include inadequate safety measures, lack of training, and unsafe equipment.
 
 
 
• **Workplace Safety Training:**
 
 
• Workplace safety training involves educating employees about protocols to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.
 
• It is often mandated by government regulations and includes drills, workshops, and certifications.
